I will still plant all 3.0 mu with cotton, same as before, because this is a small piece of land and I know this crop well. At my age, I do not want to gamble on something unfamiliar. I usually start from what worked last year and only move a little. Cotton eats fertilizer, and if I hold back too much, the bolls come small and the yield drops fast, so I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than lose the harvest. But my land is only 3 mu and I do the work myself, so I also watch every yuan. I will use improved seed, because now the better seed is more even and cleaner, and if neighbors get a steadier stand with it, I will follow that. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage because it is easier on a small plot and saves labor. For fertilizer, I will put enough base fertilizer so the seedlings start strong, then topdress nitrogen later when the plants begin growing fast. With well irrigation, I can water when the field is really dry, so I will plan about 3 irrigations in the season. Pests in cotton cannot be ignored, so I will be ready to spray about 4 times, more if the year turns bad, but for the plan I will count 4. If weather is normal and I manage it on time, I will aim for about 350 kg per mu.
